description:
Create, send, and sign documents directly inside ChatGPT with Jotform Sign. Simply describe what you need to generate a signature-ready document, or upload an existing document to get started. Customize and refine your document through conversation.

Create contracts, agreements, consent forms, and approval documents in minutes. Add recipients, configure signing order, customize fields, and send documents for e-signature—all without switching between tools. Track document status, manage signature requests, and keep every signing workflow moving from one place.

Perfect for contracts, onboarding, approvals, waivers, and other documents that require signatures.

Key Features:
- Create signature-ready documents from natural language prompts
- Generate contracts, agreements, consent forms, and approval documents
- Customize signature fields, dates, initials, and other fillable fields
- Preview and edit documents inline without leaving the AI workspace
- Refine and revise documents in draft mode before sending them for signature
- Configure recipients, signing roles, signing order, and approval workflows
- Send documents for e-signature in just a few clicks
- Track signing status and manage signature requests


Create documents for every signing workflow, including:
- Employment contracts and onboarding documents
- Client agreements and service contracts
- NDAs and confidentiality agreements
- Consent forms and liability waivers
- Sales proposals and approval requests
- Vendor and partnership agreements
- Rental and lease agreements
- Internal policies, acknowledgments, and approvals

defaultPrompt: Create an online residential signable lease agreement document
Send residential lease agreement to john.doe@example.com (landlord) and jane.doe@example.com (tenant) for both parties to sign
